2610.09139.title: Breaking the Space Barrier and its Application to Language Model Inference
2610.09139.paper_summary: Language models are more and more often asked for structured output: JSON that follows a schema, or a tool call with typed arguments. A small machine, an automaton, enforces the format by forbidding the tokens that would break it. We observe that this machine has a rare property: from any of its states, each token leads along exactly one path. Graphs in which only a few paths join any two points are a classical object of complexity theory, and our theoretical result settles an open question about them: one can decide whether such a graph connects two points while verifying that it really has few paths, with very little memory. Precisely, the problem lies in the classes ReachUL, LOGDCFL, C=L and SC2, and needs only O(log2 n/ log log n) space, below the classical O(log2 n) of Savitch's theorem. The constructions behind the proofs become an inference engine: text the format forces is written without running the model, the mask is recomputed on the GPU without any table, recursive formats use a small stack, every output stays valid under a token limit, and independent fields are decoded in parallel and verified. On one 16 GB Apple M2 Pro with Qwen3.5-2B and 4B, against MLX with llguidance, the standard setup for this hardware, schema-constrained extraction finishes 1.2- 1.3x sooner with the same answers, a grammar costs 3 MB instead of up to 1.5 GB, one server holds sixteen grammars where tables run out of memory, and sixteen tool-calling agents finish 2.5x sooner.
2610.09139.paper_summary_zh: 語言模型越來越常被要求提供結構化輸出：遵循架構的 JSON，或帶有類型參數的工具調用。一個小型機器，一個自動機，通過禁止會破壞格式的標記來強制執行格式。我們觀察到這台機器具有一個罕見的特性：從它的任何狀態，每個標記都精確地沿著一條路徑前進。只有少數幾條路徑連接任何兩個點的圖形是複雜性理論中的一個經典對象，我們的理論結果解決了關於它們的一個未解問題：可以在驗證這樣的圖形確實有少數路徑的同時，決定這樣的圖形是否連接兩個點，所需的內存非常少。具體而言，問題涉及類別 ReachUL、LOGDCFL、C=L 和 SC2，只需要 O(log2 n/ log log n) 的空間，低於 Savitch 定理的經典 O(log2 n)。證明背後的構造成為一個推理引擎：格式強制的文本在不運行模型的情況下編寫，掩碼在 GPU 上重新計算而不需要任何表格，遞歸格式使用小堆棧，每個輸出在標記限制下保持有效，獨立字段並行解碼並驗證。在一台配備 Qwen3.5-2B 和 4B 的 16 GB Apple M2 Pro 上，與使用 llguidance 的 MLX 相比，這種硬體的標準設置下，受架構約束的提取完成的時間比相同答案快 1.2-1.3 倍，語法的大小為 3 MB，而不是高達 1.5 GB，一台伺服器可以容納十六個語法，而表格會耗盡內存，十六個工具調用代理的完成速度快 2.5 倍。
